functional.question: How many sellers are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many products are in the catalogue?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(product_id) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders are there in total?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders have been delivered?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many distinct product categories are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the most products, using the Portuguese category names?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products AS p JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average product weight in grams?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(product_weight_g) AS average_product_weight FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 states have the most sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the highest price paid for a single item?
functional.sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price_paid FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many order items are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_item_id) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT pt.product_category_name_english AS category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY pt.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average freight value per item?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS average_freight_value FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers sell the most distinct products?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count FROM sellers AS s JOIN order_items AS oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY distinct_product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders are there in each status?
functional.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What was the total revenue in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(T2.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.order_approved_at) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
What is the average number of items per order?
Which 5 seller states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders contain more than one item?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id HAVING COUNT(T2.order_item_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers received the most orders?
What is the total freight cost across all order items?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_cost FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which month of 2017 had the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: What is the average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What was the total revenue in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_approved_at) AS year, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many sellers have sold products in more than 3 different categories?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT products.product_category_name) > 3 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest freight cost as a share of revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight, (SUM(oi.freight_value) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.price)) AS freight_share FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY freight_share DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories are sold by the most distinct sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ois.seller_id) AS seller_count FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS ois ON o.order_id = ois.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON ois.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN products AS p ON ois.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average revenue per seller?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.price) AS average_revenue_per_seller FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T2.seller_id = T3.seller_id WHERE NOT T1.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY T3.seller_id LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were delivered later than the estimated delivery date?
Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue in 2018?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_approved_at >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_approved_at < '2019-01-01' AND NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_share FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average freight cost per item?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_cost FROM order_items AS oi JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY avg_freight_cost DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many sellers generated more revenue than the average seller?
Which 5 product categories have the heaviest average product weight?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category_name, AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS average_weight FROM products AS p JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY average_weight DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders have not been delivered yet?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created', 'approved') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average delivery time in days?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_city, c.customer_state, AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_delivered_carrier_date)) AS INTEGER)) AS average_delivery_time FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_city, c.customer_state LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average time in hours between an order being placed and approved?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG((STRFTIME('%s', order_approved_at) - STRFTIME('%s', order_purchase_timestamp)) / 3600) AS average_time_hours FROM orders JOIN order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id WHERE order_status = 'approved' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average revenue per order?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.price) AS average_revenue_per_order FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE NOT T1.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which single order had the highest total value?
functional.sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest average order value?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(oi.price) AS average_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer cities placed the most orders?
How many customers have placed more than one order?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What share of customers are repeat buyers?
Which payment types are used most often?
functional.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average number of payment instalments?
What is the total value paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_credit_card_payments FROM order_payments JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE NOT orders.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue, named in English?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were paid in more than one instalment?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM order_payments AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T1.payment_installments > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total item revenue from orders paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS total_item_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id JOIN order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered' AND order_payments.payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What percentage of orders were paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.order_id) AS credit_card_percentage FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN order_payments AS op ON o.order_id = op.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT op.payment_type) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid with a voucher combined with another payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) FROM order_payments AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T1.payment_type = 'voucher' AND T1.payment_type <> 'voucher' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the median delivery time in days?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_carrier_date)) AS INTEGER)) AS median_delivery_time FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY median_delivery_time LIMIT 1

functional.question: Which 5 customer states have the slowest average delivery time?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_time FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_time ASC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of order items were bought from a seller in the same state as the customer?
Which 5 customer states rely most on sellers from other states?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN sellers AS s ON c.customer_id = s.seller_id WHERE c.customer_state <> s.seller_state GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5
